title: Flaky Spiral Paratha
summary: Thin dough brushed with ghee, pleated, coiled and rolled out, then cooked on a tawa until golden and flaky.
equipment: tawa or large heavy frying pan

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Mix the flour, salt, sugar, oil and water and knead 5 min until soft and smooth; cover and rest 30 min.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Divide into 6 balls and roll each as thin as you can, about 25 cm across.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Brush with ghee, dust with flour, then pleat it back and forth like a paper fan into a long strip.

steps.title: Coil
steps.text: Stretch the strip gently, wind it into a tight spiral and tuck the end underneath; rest 10 min, then roll out to 18 cm.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook on the hot tawa over medium-high heat 1-2 min, flip, brush with ghee, and keep turning and brushing until golden in spots on both sides.

steps.title: Fluff
steps.text: While hot, clap or scrunch it between your hands to open the layers.

tips: Roll the dough very thin for more layers.
Rest the coils so they roll out without springing back.
storage: Keep wrapped for 1 day or freeze; reheat on a dry pan. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
